summary.en: AWS managed service for foundation models with enterprise security and scalability.
summary.zh: AWS 托管的基础模型服务，具备企业级安全性和可扩展性。

title.en: Amazon Bedrock API Key - AWS Foundation Models | Get Model Key
title.zh: Amazon Bedrock API Key - AWS 基础模型 | Get Model Key

description.en: Get Amazon Bedrock API key for AWS foundation models. Access Claude, Llama, Titan and more on AWS.
description.zh: 获取 Amazon Bedrock API Key，访问 AWS 基础模型。在 AWS 上使用 Claude、Llama、Titan 等模型。

en: Amazon Bedrock is AWS’s managed foundation-model service, exposing multiple providers’ models behind AWS IAM, VPC, and regional controls.
It fits teams that already run on AWS and need enterprise governance, model choice, and pay-as-you-go inference without self-managing GPUs.
Bedrock is a cloud managed platform (multi-model gateway on AWS), not a single-lab API site. Get Model Key only links to the AWS Bedrock console; we do not sell keys.
zh: Amazon Bedrock 是 AWS 托管的基础模型服务，在 IAM、VPC 与区域管控下接入多家模型。
适合已在 AWS 上运行、需要企业治理与多模型选择、又不想自建 GPU 的团队。
Bedrock 属于云托管多模型平台，不是单一实验室直连站。Get Model Key 仅跳转 AWS Bedrock 控制台，不售卖密钥。

en: Sign in to the AWS Management Console with an account that can use Bedrock.
Open Bedrock (for example the us-east-1 Bedrock home) and request model access for the models you need.
Create IAM credentials or roles with Bedrock invoke permissions—Bedrock uses AWS auth, not a standalone vendor key page.
Call Bedrock Runtime APIs from your region using those AWS credentials and the model IDs shown in console docs.
zh: 使用具备 Bedrock 权限的账号登录 AWS 管理控制台。
进入 Bedrock（如 us-east-1 Bedrock 首页），为所需模型申请访问权限。
创建带 Bedrock 调用权限的 IAM 用户/角色——Bedrock 走 AWS 鉴权，不是独立厂商 Key 页。
在目标区域用上述凭证与控制台/文档中的模型 ID 调用 Bedrock Runtime API。

question.en: Do I get a single “Bedrock API key” like OpenAI?
question.zh: Bedrock 是否像 OpenAI 一样有一把独立 API Key？

answer.en: Usually no. Access is via AWS IAM credentials plus per-model access grants in the Bedrock console.
answer.zh: 一般不是。访问依赖 AWS IAM 凭证，并在 Bedrock 控制台为各模型开通权限。

answer.en: Bedrock aggregates foundation models such as AWS Nova, Anthropic Claude, Llama, Titan, and others; the live list depends on region and access status.
answer.zh: Bedrock 聚合 AWS Nova、Anthropic Claude、Llama、Titan 等基础模型；可用列表因区域与开通状态而异。

question.en: Does Get Model Key sell AWS Bedrock access?
question.zh: Get Model Key 会售卖 Bedrock 访问权限吗？

answer.en: No. We only link to the official AWS Bedrock console. All billing stays on your AWS account.
answer.zh: 不会。本站只提供官方 Bedrock 控制台入口，费用记在你的 AWS 账号。
